system.description: Aside from this protocol summoning up a floating mass of roiling shadow that feeds on Essence and ambient light known as a tenebrapede, this protocol functions like the sorcerous spell Conjure the Azure Chariot (see The Books of Sorcery, Vol. II--The White Treatise, p. 41), save that its effects last for (the Exalt's Essence x 4) hours and can be cast at any time.
